questions.stem: Which of the following is the SI base unit for mass?
questions.explanation: The kilogram (kg) is the SI base unit for mass. Although grams are commonly used, the kilogram is the official base unit in the International System of Units.

questions.stem: A physical quantity consists of which two parts?

options.text: A numerical value and a unit
A prefix and a base unit

questions.explanation: A physical quantity always has two parts: a numerical value (the magnitude) and a unit (what is being measured). For example, 5 metres has the value 5 and the unit metres.
